summary: Thank you, Sabine, your scope is now locked. Saif will send you the price quote and timeline next, and he’ll be in touch about the remaining details once the build starts.
understood: Priorities: advocacy clients first, then training, then consulting and training for organizations, then care packages.
Families start with a free consultation, simple packages can be bought directly, and organizations get a proposal.
Client accounts include appointments, signing forms online, private messages, case updates, uploading bills and records, paying invoices, and hours used on monthly plans.
CNA course opens for registration with a deposit right away, with a weekly live online class, online modules and quizzes, a final exam, in-person skills lab and clinical hours.
Specialty trainings are a mix of online lessons and in-person sessions.
Store at launch: four care boxes (each also without scripture) and build-your-own, one flat shipping fee per order, and supplements shown as “coming soon”.
